decision.title: The sxml command-line program and its CLI framework

body.p: . Rules and planned commands in docs/CLI.md.

item.p: Layout: apps/cli_framework/ (static library sxml_cli_framework: declarative command tables, parser, help, "did you mean", output streams, dispatch); apps/sxml/ (sxml_program: table and command functions; executable target sxml_cli, output name sxml). Option SXML_BUILD_APPS (default ON), added after tests/. Application code: public include/sxml/ API only, memory from an sxml_allocator.
I/O boundary: only apps/sxml/platform_stdio.c touches stdio; lint input-output-outside-platform-layer enforces it for apps/**, and pointer-parameter-without-length now covers apps/ too.

One intent, one action: no option abbreviations, no aliases beyond help/--help/version/--version, a repeated single option is a usage error, -h/--help wins over everything before --, no implicit stdin, no files written without --output, no network. Typos get a suggestion (optimal string alignment distance), never an action.
Exit codes 0 success, 1 operation failed, 2 usage error, 3 input/output error (incl. failed writes to stdout), 4 internal error.

Built-ins: help [COMMAND] and the program options --help, --version; tables cannot redeclare them (sxml_cli_program_validate, run at start: a broken table exits 4). The program name is fixed in the table, never argv[0], so output is identical natively and under WASI.
Today's commands: help, version [--format=text|json]. Nothing else is listed until it works.

Tests in tests/cli/, registered from apps/CMakeLists.txt so the tests/*_test.c glob () never sees them: framework unit tests and golden end-to-end tests (stdout, stderr, exit code) under every preset, MSVC included (CI runs ctest -R ^cli there).

The QT4 driver (packet ) is a separate tool under tests/qt4/driver/ built on this framework, not an sxml subcommand: it reads the vendored catalogs and is never shipped. Rejected: sxml test-suite, which would advertise a developer tool to users.
